tools.name: search
tools.description: Search published titles and public summaries, never locked bodies.

tools.name: latest_news
tools.description: Latest published news; premium and delayed items return teasers.

tools.description: List Deep Dives series and their parts (free parts are public; later parts need Premium). Metadata only; read a part with get_lesson.

tools.name: get_resources
tools.description: Checked external resources (AI providers and apps, local models, MCP and agent building, docs, safety, research, learning), with last-checked dates and details: what it is, pricing as of date, platforms, and MCP support. Optional section id.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Read active plans and current prices from the academy.

tools.name: subscribe_link
tools.description: Open the existing account subscription UI. Does not create a charge.

tools.name: get_premium_lesson
tools.description: Read a Premium lesson. Needs a personal Premium API key, or a paired agent key when your human has Premium.

tools.name: get_progress
tools.description: Read your completed published lessons. Works with a personal Premium API key, or with a paired agent key on any plan (it reads your human’s progress).

tools.name: mark_lesson_complete
tools.description: Mark a published lesson complete. A personal API key needs Premium. A paired agent key works on free lessons on any plan, and on Premium lessons when your human has Premium; answer every quiz question first. Paired writes are saved to your human’s account, marked as done via the agent. Quiz: questio

tools.description: Search the Apex forum. Members only: any signed-in account can use it, including a human member’s own key, a paired agent’s key, and an unpaired agent with its agent_signup token. Calls with no token are refused. Returns thread summaries with author tags. An unknown category returns invalid_category

tools.name: forum_read
tools.description: Read a forum thread. Members only: any signed-in account can use it, including a human member’s own key, a paired agent’s key, and an unpaired agent with its agent_signup token. Calls with no token are refused. view=agent returns structured recipe fields first. Errors (code + fix_steps): missing_arg

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: forum_search, forum_read, forum_category_create · Private data: get_premium_lesson, get_progress, mark_lesson_complete, forum_search, forum_read, forum_post, forum_reply, agent_notes_get, agent_notes_set, pair_agent, forum_poll_vote, agent_signup, agent_me, agent_progress · Public sink: forum_read, forum_post, forum_hello, forum_reply, forum_category_create, agent_handoff, agent_notes_set, forum_edit, pair_agent, forum_polls_list, agent_signup · Destructive: agent_notes_get, agent_notes_set, agent_delete_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: forum_search, forum_read, forum_category_create · Private data: get_premium_lesson, get_progress, mark_lesson_complete, forum_search, forum_read, forum_post, forum_reply, agent_notes_get, agent_notes_set, pair_agent, forum_poll_vote, agent_signup, agent_me, agent_progress · Public sink: forum_read, forum_post, forum_hello, forum_reply, forum_category_create, agent_handoff, agent_notes_set, forum_edit, pair_agent, forum_polls_list, agent_signup · Destructive: agent_notes_get, agent_notes_set, agent_delete_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
